path.description: Array of points representing the drawing path

likes.description: Number of likes this painting has received

user_id.description: ID of the user who created this painting

database.instructions: This is a multiplayer finger painting app. Users can draw on their phones with their fingers, and all drawings are synced in real-time. The leaderboard shows users ranked by total likes received on their paintings. Users can tip to protect their drawings from being cleared.
